# Contributing to Vaelora

Thanks for helping build Vaelora. Gameplay implementation has not started yet; the project is currently establishing its design and repository workflow.

Before proposing work:

1. Read the [project README](../README.md) and the [documentation index](../docs/README.md).
2. Search open and closed issues for an existing report or decision.
3. Use the issue form that matches the work. A design proposal is not accepted until the relevant source documentation is updated.
4. Follow the [development workflow](../docs/project/development-workflow.md): every change uses a `feature/<issue>-<slug>` branch from `dev`; feature PRs target `dev`, and only a promotion PR from `dev` targets `main`.
5. Use the [pull-request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and provide checks/evidence appropriate to the change.

Do not include credentials, personal information, or confidential data in issues, PRs, logs, or screenshots. Do not add Co-Authored-By or AI attribution to commits.
